venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Sunday 9/20.** Close Company Atlanta is closed on Sundays; no EON report is submitted. Dark day, not an outstanding report.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Sun 9/20 (MOD KE; Chef DM).** Net $804 vs $1,154 target (70%); food $107; comps $26 (3.2%); ~27 guests / $29.78 avg. Weather very warm. Rather slow Sunday — very few people in house or outside, a bit of a ghost town, possibly Americanafest-related. Made early cuts to offset the slow pace. A handful of English visitors in Titans jerseys had a pleasant time. Kitchen: DM worked on cleaning projects and reviewed garnish standards with KE. No incident; no-shows not charged. Favorite: two young women (a one-year transplant showing her visiting friend her 'favorite bar') stayed 1.5 hrs over daiquiris. Entered by BC.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Sun 9/20 (AM Maggie H.; PM Carey).** Net $8,463.53 vs $10,831 target (78%); DC/AM $1,025.83, D&C PM $7,437.70, Garden/6A $1,647.06; food $1,944.15; no events; comps $186.80 (2.21%); 147 guests (Tock) / ~$57.57 avg. Weather rainy. AM: super slow, chill Sunday with Care and Felix, tiny pop at the end; cold brew strained — thank you Heather. PM: very slow evening — 'this answers whether we are an after-party for home games... no, we are not.' Garden: rained out early, no fro-spro, very chill afternoon — thanks Kim. Kitchen: very slow Sunday for Fiellah and Dante with a decent pop around 9pm; Dante left a little early — thanks Rand. Break make-up complete. No-shows not charged. No incident, no maintenance needs. Favorite: everyone's attitude throughout an uneventful evening. Entered by Carey.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Sun 9/20 (MOD Kyler; Chef Will).** Net $4,543 vs $4,227 target (107%); food $627, beverage $3,913; no events; comps $109.78 ('swarmed by so many friends'); 125 guests (Sevenrooms) / $36 avg. Weather: periodic rain led to choppy influxes and outfluxes. Beautifully symphonic night — waves of guests, incredible conversations, bespoke rounds, quick shifts — with interludes of total quiet; staff had the juice to go 200%. Bespoke back-catalog: Reptilian (funky aromatic gimlet) for a post-Frick father/son duo. 125 covers, 2 large parties, 6 solos, 0 investors. Top sellers: tequila shots, King Mambo / Gatlin Gun (tie). Kitchen: great work on a late pitch; full kitchen tonight. Door: strong opening, half-full by 6:45 and near capacity by 7:30 with lots of two-tops and solos; emptied ~8:30, refilled by 9:15, steady until ~11:30. Several guests called it 'the best bar experience they've ever had'; visitors from DC, LA and Denver trying the OG spot. No-shows: Matthew Thomas (2 @ 9:30), Alyssa Grapes (2 @ 11:00) — not charged. Menu count 18. Entered by Thomas.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Sun 9/20 (MOD Joe + Angel + Josh).** Net $4,316 vs $5,234 target (82%); food $955; Standing Room closed ($0); comps $198 (Said, Uly + Javier, investor, birthday, DNL); 137 guests / ~$31.50 avg (form reported $74.43). Fairly steady Sunday — sleepy first hour used for cleaning and prep; gradually busier with the usual ~9pm push and familiar faces; room mostly full until 11pm then mellowed, few walk-ins in the last hour. Angel's last training night — knocked it out of the park. Kitchen: nice work. Maintenance: water system — Brian sending someone tomorrow. No incident; no-shows charged. Favorite: a regular dropped off a cheesecake for the staff. Entered by Joe.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Sun 9/20 (MOD Josh).** Net incl. events $1,548.63 vs $2,551 target (61%); Marquee bar $1,611.54, Garden closed, food $184; no events; comps $62.91; 51 guests / $30.37 GCA (CA $72.99). Weather beautiful. Slow night with extremely light neighborhood foot traffic during the Commanders vs. Cowboys game; first guests ~5:45pm, picked up an hour later, mostly two- and three-tops; a late 12-top closed things out on a good note. Team stayed engaged, connected with guests and reset the space during lulls. Kitchen: light night, only a handful of plates; kept open for the late 12-top. Went well: guest connection, ABK. Maintenance: curtains, hot water heater. No incident; no-shows not charged. Favorite: the 12-top celebrating an engagement with speeches from friends. Entered by Josh.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Sun 9/20 (AM Justin + Shannon; PM Justin/James + Shannon).** Net $6,997 vs $7,712 target (91%); Municipal Bar AM $3,880 / PM $2,596, Sun Club $319, Hot Eye $1,018; food $3,160; event $0; comps $404; 176 guests (OpenTable 134 AM + 42 PM) / ~$39.76 avg. Weather hot and clear. AM: good 8am pop, quiet until 11:30, then three servers busy with reservations and two large food tours with no support; brunch servers cut once Sam B. arrived at 2. PM: everyone partied out from the weekend — very slow; cut cautiously down to Catie, Jonathan and MOD. Sun Club: slow start, picked up late, lots of banana daiquiris. Hot Eye: opening pop from a NY service-industry wedding crew, long lull, 9pm bar crawl, then a solid industry crowd to close. Kitchen: slow, mostly training meals; no lows or 86s. No incident. Favorite: Nathan from Brochu's celebrated his birthday with industry friends in THE. Entered by Alexis.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Sun 9/20 (MOD Curtis Hayes).** Net $10,203 vs $8,000 target (128%); food $1,567; event $0; comps $390.14 (DNLs high at $192); 196 guests / $50.01 avg. Weather high of 67, bright and sunny. Illness hitting the crew hard (Alexis, Alex T, Julian and Josh all under the weather; not covid) but the team cruised to $10.2K. Hospitality level on 'slower' days is palpable; Malachi got the whole waitlist in with great door pacing; some investors seated. Tons of compliments on the music (funk early, Mark Morrison Radio at 7:30, Tribe Called Quest to close). An impromptu 16-person flash photoshoot is prompting a no-flash-photography stance. Alex S and Daisey held the floor; Mitchell held court in the 200 section; Alexis held down service. Note: alerted security to a person going through trash and another doing apparent credit-card scamming on a computer plugged into an alley outlet — both removed; no incident. Kitchen: Josh rocked it solo while sick, R&R coming; Sfian solo Tuesday. Maintenance: Autochlor emailed for chemicals; kitchen dishwasher plunger too short to seal. No 86s. No-shows not charged. Favorite: multiple guests who've visited several D&Cs called this their favorite; Allison Tolman from St. Denis Medical came in. Entered by Curtis Hayes.
